text:
Alex: Heads-up — Savings Plan/reserved coverage shows a weird drop for eu-west-1 p4d reservations starting the Feb billing window. Dashboard went from ~65% -> ~30% used. Anyone else seeing this?
Tess: Can you paste the query/export you used?
Alex: Pulled from cost-explorer (Reservation Utilization by region+instance). Export link: https://redwood-internal/ce/exports/2145678901 (internal)
Mohit: Ran a raw CE query just now:
```
aws ce get-reservation-utilization --time-period Start=2026-02-01,End=2026-02-28 --granularity=MONTHLY
```
Result: eu-west-1 / p4d -> 37% utilization, spend still high. Suspect tag drift + some instances not mapping to RIs.
Julia: We pushed an autoscaler tweak mid-Feb and also renamed the cluster tag key from `env` -> `environment` in a migration. That will break RI matching.
Tess: Reminder that Savings Plans vs Regional RIs scoping can be confusing — if some compute moved between AZs or accounts, SPs may not cover it.
Alex: DeployBot posted alert: `ANOMALY: reserved-coverage-decline eu-west-1 p4d 2026-02-26` — saw that too.
DeployBot: billing-runner v3.2 triggered anomaly alert for reserved-coverage decline (auto-post).
FinanceBot: Uploaded raw invoice/line-item CSV to s3://redwood-billing/invoices/2026-02/line_items.csv
Mohit: Proposed triage steps:
1) run reconcile script to map active instances -> RI/SP lineitems
2) identify orphaned/untagged instances and re-tag or move
3) evaluate RI exchange or Savings Plan tilt before renewal window
I'll run the recon now: `./scripts/reconcile_ris.sh --region eu-west-1 --instance-type p4d`
Alex: Paste top-level output when done please.
Mohit: Quick output snippet: `orphan_count=42 matched=278 unmatched_spend=12345.67` — looks like 42 instances (or hours-equivalent) not matching RIs.
Julia: Those 42 align with Feb 14–18 stress test runs from dev — we accidentally launched some reserved-backed instances for dev. I'll patch the deployment job to add `cost:center=dev` tag and exclude reserved instance types.
Tess: Action owners:
- Mohit: reconcile + patch tags (ETA 2h)
- Julia: add CI guard to avoid reserved instance types in dev (ETA end of day)
- Alex: open renewal decision doc for finance with current utilization and orphan list (ETA today)
Alex: Also checking if we can do an RI exchange for unused coverage vs a smaller regional tilt. If we need urgent reallocate, I'll coordinate with sales for marketplace options.
Tess: Scheduling a 30m sync in #eng-scheduling in 15m to decide renewal posture. :calendar:
Alex: Thanks all. Please drop any new findings here.
